mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals reduced consumer demand and economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST shows a decline but SPX returns are positive in >40% of cases, or Rank IC <0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% tightens monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but SPX shows positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises but SPX returns are positive in >40% of cases, or Rank IC <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases, or Rank IC <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both RSAFS and HOUST rise but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS declines but SPX returns are negative in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE declines but SPX returns are negative in >40% of cases, or Rank IC <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) indicates reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines but SPX returns are positive in >40% of cases, or Rank IC <0.05.
